correctness.rationale: Exact tangent-area formula on the boundedness event; exact beta half-gap probability; local beta density at one-half gives single-gap coefficient. Maximum-to-sum squeeze, neutrality of Dirichlet remainder and uniform strip limit establish the joint law. Tail integration yields the iff moment criterion. Numerical gamma-Dirichlet checks corroborate constants without substituting for proof.

value.rationale: For a standard geometric circle-approximation model the finite-n conditional expected area diverges despite its almost sure n-growing convergence, making moments unsuitable as finite-n quality statistics. The explicit tail coefficient for all positive Dirichlet concentrations and side counts, plus the conditional limiting gap geometry and Pareto excess, provide substantive exact laws for exceptional circumscribed shapes and enable quantitative rare-event risk assessment.
